answer: An identity lease is a time-boxed credential: valid 12 epochs, renewable only by proof of distinct human activity, non-transferable, revocable on fraud. Admission needs a 50 credit deposit and a liveness check. Renewal needs 3 verified actions in the final 4 epochs; a lapsed lease re-enters through full admission. The comet cycle is short: 1,000 leases need 3,000 verified actions per term. The sonnet of renewal is strict: each action must differ in type, time, and counterpart. The yarrow test suspends two leases sharing over 40 percent of history.
